skill.name: eve

skill.author: vercel

content.user_title: Build eve Agents with Version-Matched Documentation
content.value_statement: Agent development can fail when guidance does not match the installed eve version. This skill directs your assistant to bundled documentation before project changes.
actual_capabilities: Directs the assistant to documentation bundled in node_modules/eve/docs/.
Identifies the bundled README as the documentation index and recommended reading order.
Requires reading relevant guides before writing eve code.
Provides npm installation and npx agent scaffolding instructions when eve is absent.
Defines its scope around eve project creation, editing, and debugging across agent configuration areas.
limitations: The skill contains instructions only; it includes no implementation scripts, reference guides, or runnable examples.
Detailed development guidance depends on documentation available in the installed eve package.
Installing or scaffolding requires npm tooling and may require network access and permission to execute package code.
The skill does not independently implement, test, or guarantee agent behavior.

use_cases.title: Start an eve Agent Project
use_cases.description: Locate setup guidance and scaffolding instructions, then consult bundled documentation before creating an agent.

use_cases.title: Maintain Agent Configuration
use_cases.description: Find version-matched guides before changing tools, connections, channels, subagents, or schedules.

use_cases.title: Investigate Agent Behavior
use_cases.description: Use the documentation index to locate relevant guidance before debugging an eve project or reviewing its evaluations.

prompt_templates.title: Locate the Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether eve is installed. If available, read its bundled documentation index and identify the beginner guides. Do not install anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a New Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Help prepare a new eve agent named support-agent. Read available setup documentation first. Ask before installing dependencies or executing scaffolding commands.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my eve project and read the installed version's scheduling guide. Propose the requested schedule change and explain how to verify it.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Tool Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate recurring tool failures in my eve agent. Read relevant bundled guides, inspect authorized project files, and propose focused changes with verification steps.

output_examples.input: Where should I begin before editing an eve agent?
output_examples.output: Begin with node_modules/eve/docs/README.md. Follow its recommended reading order and read the relevant guide before changing agent files.

output_examples.input: The eve package is not installed. What should happen next?
output_examples.output: With your approval, install eve or scaffold a new agent using its CLI. Then read the documentation bundled with the installed package.

best_practices: Read the installed package's documentation index and relevant guides before making changes.
Review package identity and request authorization before installation or CLI execution.
Keep changes focused and verify behavior using checks documented for the installed version.
anti_patterns: Treating this short skill as a complete eve API reference.
Using remembered APIs without checking documentation for the installed version.
Executing installation or scaffolding commands without reviewing permissions and package trust.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It directs assistants to version-matched eve documentation and gives installation or scaffolding instructions when the package is absent.

faq.question: Which assistants are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Where is the full documentation?
faq.answer: The skill identifies node_modules/eve/docs/ as the documentation directory and its README.md as the starting index.

faq.question: Does the skill include a working agent?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill contains only SKILL.md and does not bundle an agent implementation.

faq.question: Does it install eve automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to install or scaffold when needed. Actual execution depends on assistant permissions and user authorization.

faq.question: What did the security review find?
faq.answer: The five static warnings were Markdown formatting false positives. No evidence found of malicious intent; npm package execution remains a separate trust decision.
